subject.title: feat(cron): serve cron run history from the task ledger

question: Should the task-ledger read-source flip land only after cron retention and doctor-owned upgrade reconciliation are complete, or may this release intentionally accept the staged compatibility risks?
rationale: The PR deliberately stages a persistent storage-authority change across two pull requests, but the current boundary changes shipped retention and migration behavior; only maintainers can choose the acceptable release sequence.

options.title: Complete safety boundaries first
options.body: Add per-source cron retention and doctor-owned thin-mirror reconciliation before switching external history reads to the ledger.

options.title: Split the read switch
options.body: Land full-fidelity ledger writes and recovery preparation now, but keep cron.runs on cron_run_logs until the follow-up migration and retention work lands.

options.title: Accept staged upgrade risk
options.body: Merge the current read switch while explicitly accepting shortened visible history, duplicate legacy task rows, and database-open migration exposure.

recommendation.title: Complete safety boundaries first
recommendation.body: Add per-source cron retention and doctor-owned thin-mirror reconciliation before switching external history reads to the ledger.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked staging plan, the current branch, and most of the relevant cron persistence and migration history.
